name: Angry Petes Pizza Point Loma
notes: 3 menu photos, but they show three different revisions of this restaurant's menu with conflicting prices and item sets (e.g. Loose Burger $6 vs $5, Chicken Tenders $9 vs $8, and photos 1-2 list several pizzas/sides absent from photo 3, or vice versa). Used photo 3 (a single laminated in-restaurant board covering both pizza sections and Comfort Food, fully legible, internally consistent) as the sole source rather than merging conflicting revisions. Blanket per-slice prices ('Any Slice $5.50/$6') were omitted as they are not named dishes.
